sentence: Revenue reacts only past an adoption-intensity threshold and grows where complementary technologies and internal R&D stand behind the investment [CITE]; the funding payoff turns at roughly USD 11.3 million
passage: [Banna & Alam (2025), sec. 4.1] "the turning point is observed at a log AI investment value of approximately 2.425 [ ] corresponding to approximately USD 11.3 million in AI-related venture funding. This suggests that firms investing below this level may face short term performance declines, while those exceeding this threshold begin to realise the long-term benefits of AI adoption"

gemini.overclaim: and grows where complementary technologies and internal R&D stand behind the investment
gemini.note: The passage confirms the USD 11.3 million threshold for performance benefits but contains no mention of complementary technologies or internal R&D.
